Title: Ayaan and the Family

Cast

1. Ayaan - 8 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Sunita - 38 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Ayaan, what's the plan today?"

[Ayaan scratches his head.]

Ayaan (surprised): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Ayaan carries his school bag on his back.]

Ayaan (softly): "This is amazing!"

[Ayaan trips over a stone.]

Ayaan: "And then?"

[Thunder rumbles in the distance.]

Ayaan: "What happened?"

[The sun is blazing and Ayaan is sweating.]

Ayaan: "That's easy."

[Ayaan milks the cow.]

Sunita: "Slowly, take it easy."

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Ayaan: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Ayaan stands by the road. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "What a nice place."

[Ayaan gets off the school bus.]

Sunita: "One more time!"

[Ayaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Ayaan (happily): "Okay, Mom."

Scene 3: The snowy hillside - Day

[Ayaan stands in the snow. Sunita stands near him.]

Ayaan: "Let's begin."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Sunita: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ayaan makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Ayaan: "Hmm, I see."

[Ayaan builds a snowman.]

Ayaan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ayaan slides down the snowy slope.]

Ayaan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
